title: AI Fashion Reels for Clothing Try-On | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI fashion reels from one clothing photo for TikTok, Instagram and product pages. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds for each social campaign you run.
h1: AI Fashion Reels That Show the Full Outfit
lead: Pick a try-on scene and add one garment photo, so shoppers see the whole look in motion.
steps_h2: Make a Clothing Video Ad in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One garment photo, a short line about the action, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Show the full garment flat, on a hanger, or on a mannequin. Keep the color even and the edges in frame.
Name one action, such as a turn or a short walk. Then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add the size or price in your editor. Check the color against the garment before you post.

faq.q: What is an AI fashion reel template?
faq.a: A ready try-on scene that puts one outfit in motion. You add a photo of the garment, and the clip shows the full look.

faq.q: How do I make the outfit reel?
faq.a: Upload the garment, name one action such as a turn or a short walk, pick a size and a length, then download the file.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a fitting day?
faq.a: The try-on is built from the garment photo you already have. You can skip another shoot until you decide you need one.
Clothing shops, including menswear and womenswear, that need a reel, a listing, or a paid ad from one garment photo.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo of the full garment and name one action, such as a turn or a short walk. Check the color against the garment before you post.
A sharp, evenly lit photo of the full garment. A flat lay, a hanger, or a mannequin can work.

faq.q: What should I check before posting?
faq.a: Compare the color, the fit, and the silhouette with the source photo. Add the real size and price in your editor.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for TikTok and Reels. You can also pick 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your store, on a product page, or in paid ads. Add any platform disclosure yourself. The person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer.
